locate-known-symbol.description: Locate definition or occurrences of a known identifier or path.

locate-concept.description: Find implementation of an abstract feature or business logic.

trace-dependency.description: Trace callers, callees, or module dependencies.

estimate-blast-radius.description: Assess downstream impact of modifying a symbol or file.

inspect-history.description: Understand why code was changed or view recent commits.

verify-runtime-behavior.description: Verify behavior against unit, integration, or regression tests.

compress-command.description: Execute large-output CLI command with token compression.

extract-document.description: Extract text or structured data from local document or image files.

transcribe-media.description: Transcribe local audio or video recording to plain text or subtitles.

compress-text.description: Semantically compress long text or conversation history while preserving context.
